rootCause.change: added the line '  volume REAL CHECK (volume IS NULL OR volume >= 0),' inside the inline migration 026_research_closed_candles
rootCause.whyItIsFatal: schema_migrations stores a checksum per applied migration, and migrationRunner refuses to construct a database whose recorded checksum no longer matches the code, so every already-deployed database refused to boot
rootCause.whyValidationMissedIt: the guard only engages against a database that already recorded migration 026. Local tests and CI build fresh databases where every migration applies cleanly for the first time, so the suite is structurally incapable of detecting an in-place edit of applied history. Only the Oracle release step runs against the real host database, which is exactly why post-merge deploy verification exists.

Commit f312190c, authored by this session, did not touch packages/storage/src/index.ts. This session nonetheless drove that branch through Audit and Release into protected main, so the merge responsibility is recorded rather than assigned away.

checksumContract.algorithm: sha256 of `${id}\n${sql}` as computed by packages/storage/src/migrationRunner.ts
checksumContract.separatorCaveat: the template literal contains a backslash followed by 'n', not a newline. It is baked into every checksum already recorded in every deployed database, so the formula must never be corrected.
deployedValueDerivedTwoWays: hash of the 026 SQL extracted from commit a4661cc20, whose git blob is the LF form production executed
read back from schema_migrations after the current runtime created a fresh database

fix.statement: migration 026 is restored to exactly the SQL the deployed databases executed, and the identical volume column is delivered by a new migration 031_research_closed_candles_volume expressed as ALTER TABLE research_closed_candles ADD COLUMN volume REAL CHECK (volume IS NULL OR volume >= 0)
fix.sqliteAddColumnCheckNote: verified against the runtime SQLite that ADD COLUMN accepts a CHECK constraint, enforces it on negative values, and accepts NULL, which is what lets rows written before the column existed keep a NULL volume

assertions: migration 026 keeps the exact SQL every deployed database already recorded, pinned to fd3ed8fe280f054d7f62bf8e1262f3cb37be2d0c2d56b0484016fc4fbf976cb4

guard.lineEndingPortability: the guard normalizes CRLF to LF because git stores LF while core.autocrlf can present CRLF on Windows checkouts; the runtime records the LF form on every platform
